speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap)

The description of "greasy yellow scales" and worsening in cold weather is classic for seborrheic dermatitis, which fits the clinical picture better than psoriasis (typically dry, silvery scales) or infection. Given the patient's age and specific symptoms, I am confident in this assessment.
